conceptZh: 玩具戰士打翻泡泡骨牌，一連串泡泡落成「洗」字。
object: a bravado-filled toy warrior with a foam sword, a round shield and a bubbly tub
morph: a chain of tumbling soap-bubble tiles lands as 洗
creativeAngle: 玩具戰士輕輕一碰，一排泡泡骨牌連鎖倒下，水滴落成偏旁，最後洗手。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a bright aqua-and-white bathroom-tile backdrop. Lead: a chunky toy warrior in a golden helmet with a foam sword and a round shield, all bravado and little skill. The finished glyph 洗 is a saturated ocean-blue, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.7s: the warrior strides in, sword high, to battle a row of standing blue soap-bar tiles. First "洗" as his sword tip taps the first tile.
1.7-3.3s: domino pile-up: tiles topple left to right in a clatter, one flips the shield out of his hand, and bubbles burst from each. Second "洗" lands as the last tile falls flat and the strokes of the left water-radical settle.
3.3-5.0s: the remaining tiles tumble upright by luck into the right half and the glyph 洗 stands complete with a squeaky-clean twinkle.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "洗手" the warrior drops his sword, holds two cartoon hands under a little bubble foam fountain beside the glyph and scrubs, a bubble floating up and popping, his helmet fogged with suds.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "洗、洗、洗手" (ㄒㄧˇ、ㄒㄧˇ、ㄒㄧˇ ㄕㄡˇ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 洗.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

conceptZh: 布忍者以為沒人看見他，助跑衝向架上的大肥皂，煙霧彈卻提早爆開，他矇著眼撞上浴室磁磚牆「碰」一聲變扁，震落的水珠和肥皂、刷子掉下來排成「洗」，最後消防水管自己噴水，他開心地洗手。
object: a giant blue soap bar on a shelf against a bathroom tile wall, a felt ninja charging at it, and a chunky toy fire engine with a runaway hose
morph: the BONK against the tile wall shakes three water drops off the shelf that splash down as the water radical 氵, while the dropped soap bar and bath brushes clatter down to the right and stack as 先, completing 洗
creativeAngle: 改用「衝鋒撞牆」模式，不再是泡泡骨牌或靜止的鴨子。布忍者的個性（自以為隱形、煙霧彈失控）直接成為「試一次失敗」的笑點：煙霧提早爆開讓他矇著眼衝錯方向，第二次更大力助跑才真正撞牆，撞擊本身震落水珠與肥皂組成字形。消防水管只在最後出場，噴水讓他做出「洗手」的動作，聽到的詞與畫面完全對應。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated slapstick clip. Backdrop: a bright, soft aqua bathroom tile wall, flat and uncluttered. The finished glyph 洗 is a saturated deep-ocean-blue, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Lead: 布忍者, a tiny stitched felt ninja with button eyes and a flappy scarf, certain he is invisible, wildly bad at hiding, with smoke bombs that go off at the wrong moment.

0.0-1.5s: On the far right, a giant blue soap bar sits on a little shelf against the tile wall. On the far left the felt ninja "hides" behind a teacup half his size, in plain view, tiptoeing with exaggerated sneaky steps. He spots the soap, points at it with glee, digs his felt feet in and leans way back in a huge wind-up.

1.5-3.0s: First "洗" as he launches. Mid-sprint a smoke bomb at his belt pops early: a round puff of pink smoke swallows him, he keeps running blind with arms flailing, zips straight past the soap, bounces off the frame edge and skids back to the middle, scarf over his eyes. He flips the scarf up, glares at the soap, and winds up even bigger, leaning so far back he nearly tips over.

3.0-4.8s: Full-speed charge, feet a blur, then BONK: he smacks flat against the tile wall beside the shelf and squashes into a felt pancake with a soft cartoon thud. The impact rattles the shelf: three fat water drops shake loose and splash down the left side, landing one under another as the water radical 氵. The soap bar and two bath brushes bounce off the shelf, tumble to the right and stack into the strokes of 先, legs at the bottom. Second "洗" as the last piece clicks in and the whole blue glyph 洗 stands complete with a squeaky-clean sparkle. The ninja peels off the wall, wobbles, and shows a dizzy grin with little stars circling his head.

4.8-8.0s: HOLD. The glyph 洗 stays perfectly still, centered and readable. In the bottom right corner a chunky red toy fire engine rolls in; its hose rears up with a mind of its own and sprays a gentle arc of water onto the ninja. At "洗手" he happily holds out both felt hands under the spray and scrubs them, bubbles rising, soapsuds piled on his hood, never touching the strokes. He strikes a tiny proud ninja pose as one bubble pops on his nose.

Audio: an off-screen voice, warm and friendly, in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones: "洗、洗、洗手" (ㄒㄧˇ、ㄒㄧˇ、ㄒㄧˇ ㄕㄡˇ): the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, nothing after it. Soft cartoon sound effects, quiet background music under the voice. The only text on screen is the single glyph 洗; no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
